archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-contract
archetypes.rationale: Prompt compression risks dropping Step 2 manifest and guard contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed implementer prompts and generator output for contract drift. Focus on manifest fields, needs_qa flow, hard guards, atomic file writes, and dispatcher commit semantics. Check that generated Codex and Cursor prompts remain synchronized except for intentional tool-specific substitutions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
